L_NETWORK_ERROR.name: Login Network Error
L_NETWORK_ERROR.description: The device could not connect to the remote server to verify credentials. This may be due to DNS failure, the server being unreachable, or lack of internet connectivity.

L_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.name: Invalid Credentials
L_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.description: The user provided an incorrect phone number or password resulting in an HTTP 401/403 response.

L_API_TIMEOUT.name: Login API Timeout
L_API_TIMEOUT.description: The remote server took too long to respond to the login request (exceeded timeout threshold).

L_MISSING_AUTH_DATA.name: Missing Authentication Data
L_MISSING_AUTH_DATA.description: The API returned a success status code, but failed to provide a valid JWT token or Employee data in the response payload.

H_SERIAL_OPEN_ERROR.name: Serial Port Open Error
H_SERIAL_OPEN_ERROR.description: The application was unable to open the configured serial port (e.g., /dev/ttyAMA0) to communicate with the display hardware.

H_SERIAL_TIMEOUT.name: Serial Read Timeout
H_SERIAL_TIMEOUT.description: The serial port was opened successfully, but no data was received from the display during the handshake timeout window.

H_NO_DU_ASSIGNED.name: No DU Assigned
H_NO_DU_ASSIGNED.description: The server reports that there is no Dispenser Unit assigned to the currently logged-in Service Engineer.

H_DU_UPDATE_API_ERROR.name: DU_Update API Error
H_DU_UPDATE_API_ERROR.description: Failed to fetch the available firmware update list from the server (due to a network drop or HTTP error).

H_INVALID_FRAME_FORMATTING.name: Invalid Frame Formatting
H_INVALID_FRAME_FORMATTING.description: The 512-byte payload received does not have the expected SOP (Start of Packet) or EOP (End of Packet) markers.

H_CRC_VALIDATION_FAILED.name: CRC Validation Failed
H_CRC_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: Data corruption occurred in transit. The calculated CRC16 of the payload does not match the received CRC bytes.

H_FRAME_DECRYPTION_FAILED.name: Frame Decryption Failed
H_FRAME_DECRYPTION_FAILED.description: The system failed to decrypt the 512-byte payload, usually indicating an encryption key mismatch or corrupted cipher text.

H_INVALID_SERIAL_NUMBER.name: Invalid Serial Number
H_INVALID_SERIAL_NUMBER.description: The parsed DU Number or Display Number violates system format rules (e.g., wrong length, or DU not starting with 99 / Display not starting with 12).

H_INVALID_HARDWARE_TYPE.name: Invalid Hardware Type
H_INVALID_HARDWARE_TYPE.description: Byte 427 of the handshake payload contains an unrecognized hardware identifier.

D_NO_FIRMWARE_AVAILABLE.name: No Firmware Available
D_NO_FIRMWARE_AVAILABLE.description: The DU API returned an empty list of firmware files for the current hardware.

D_DOWNLOAD_API_FAILED.name: Download API Failed
D_DOWNLOAD_API_FAILED.description: The system failed to download the .bin firmware file from the server (HTTP non-200 response).

D_MISSING_HEADERS.name: Missing Headers
D_MISSING_HEADERS.description: The server response is missing critical HTTP headers, such as the encrypted Hash or the KMS Encrypted Key header.

D_ENCRYPTED_HASH_MISMATCH.name: Encrypted Hash Mismatch
D_ENCRYPTED_HASH_MISMATCH.description: The calculated SHA-256 hash of the downloaded encrypted file does not match the X-Encrypted-File-Hash provided by the server.

D_ORIGINAL_HASH_MISMATCH.name: Original Hash Mismatch
D_ORIGINAL_HASH_MISMATCH.description: The calculated SHA-256 hash of the decrypted file does not match the X-Original-File-Hash provided by the server, indicating data corruption or incorrect decryption.

D_KMS_DECRYPTION_ERROR.name: KMS Decryption Error
D_KMS_DECRYPTION_ERROR.description: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) failed to decrypt the firmware's data key.

D_AES_DECRYPTION_ERROR.name: AES File Decryption Error
D_AES_DECRYPTION_ERROR.description: The system failed to decrypt the firmware file payload using the decrypted KMS data key.

D_SERIAL_WRITE_ERROR.name: Serial Write Error
D_SERIAL_WRITE_ERROR.description: The system failed to successfully send the final 64-byte or 512-byte hash packet to the display hardware over the serial port.

D_HASH_PACKET_TIMEOUT.name: Hash Packet Timeout
D_HASH_PACKET_TIMEOUT.description: The system sent the Hash Packet successfully, but no response or acknowledgment was received back from the display.

P_FIRMWARE_UPDATE_FAILED.name: Firmware Update Failed
P_FIRMWARE_UPDATE_FAILED.description: The underlying btl_host.py process exited with a non-zero exit code, threw an internal error, or lost communication with the PIC32 bootloader during the flashing cycle.
